probe.text_sample: Inflection Award Nominate Nominate Apply +++ awardees announced +++ awardees announced Introducing → Inflection Award 01 . About Top 30 scientists working on solutions to climate change. Could you be one of them? Organised by Backed by For the first time on record, global warming has exceeded temperatures of 1.5°C over a 12-month period. Now we find ourselves at an Inflection point in the climate crisis — a defining moment in history. What we do now will dictate the course of our planet’s climate for decades to come. To keep global warming to less than 1.5°C as called for in the Paris Agreement – emissions need to reach net zero by 2050 . One-third of these reductions will rely on technologies that are still in development. To achieve this, we need to maximise the potential contribution of talented individuals and connect them with the highest impact opportunities. Inflection is the first awards programme dedicated to finding the top young scientists of tomorrow and connecting them with the highest impact opportunities to make their mark on climate change.
